topups.ko: 나는 그들이 우리를 집까지 차로 데려다주고 싶어한다고 생각해
topups.why: Fixed the Korean: a third-person desire needs 싶어한다고, not 싶다고.

topups.ko: 그들은 우리를 집까지 차로 데려다주고 싶어해?
topups.why: Fixed the Korean by adding the missing topic particle 은 to 그들.
The Welsh is fine, but all 5 USE rows are already filled with stronger candidates.
The Korean 데려다줄래 drops licio ('would like'). A Korean fix like 싶어? would clash with isio, so the prompt cannot point to one Welsh answer.
